Materialize the current cohort as canonical Parquet

Source: R/pipeline.R
import_cohort_general.Rd

Resolves every supported selection route through the shared DuckDB engine, constructs the source-native patient hierarchy with patient_context_index, definition_filter_index, and scope_index, and writes canonical Parquet directly. A transient DuckDB working file may be used while building but is removed before publication.

Usage

import_cohort_general(
  src_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  icd_filter_path = NULL,
  direct_ids_path = NULL,
  cohort = NULL,
  cohort_sql = NULL,
  setup_sql = NULL,
  cohort_fn = NULL,
  no_filter = FALSE,
  key = NULL,
  import_scope = NULL,
  allow_unmatched_ids = FALSE,
  window_sql = NULL,
  window_fn = NULL,
  tables = NULL,
  memory_limit = NULL,
  threads = NULL,
  temp_directory = NULL,
  table_chunk_rows = 5e+06,
  validate_columns = FALSE,
  ignore_errors = TRUE,
  store_rejects = TRUE,
  use_parquet_cache = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  cohort_selection = NULL,
  windows = NULL,
  loading = NULL,
  execution = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Registered source name.

base_dir

Project root.

raw_data_root

Optional parent of the source-specific raw directory.

icd_filter_path

ICD-code CSV or RDS file with an icd_code column and an icd_version column (9 or 10). icd_version is required for MIMIC-IV and eICU; for MIMIC-III it may be omitted (ICD-9 is assumed) and ICD-10 rows are excluded. A code matches only in its stated version.

direct_ids_path

CSV, CSV.GZ, Parquet, or RDS identifier file.

cohort

Bundled named cohort.

cohort_sql

Final selection query; use setup_sql for dependencies.

setup_sql

Optional ordered SQL statements or files.

cohort_fn

Function or function name returning identifiers.

no_filter

Select the whole available source.

key

Explicit configured hierarchy key.

import_scope

Patient, hospital, ICU, or configured hierarchy key.

allow_unmatched_ids

Permit a partially unmatched selection when at least one identifier matches.

window_sql, window_fn

Optional hierarchy builder override.

tables

Optional bounded table subset.

memory_limit, threads, temp_directory

Optional DuckDB resource limits.

table_chunk_rows

Row threshold (against each table's configured num_rows, no extra scan needed). Tables above it are built in multiple smaller INSERT batches (split by a hash of the cohort link-key column) instead of one single CREATE TABLE AS SELECT, so peak memory stays bounded even when DuckDB's own out-of-core spilling isn't enough for a single huge table (e.g. MIMIC-III chartevents). Default 5e6 chunks only the few tables large enough to need it; small tables are unaffected either way. Pass NULL to always build every table in one shot. Reference (unfiltered) tables are never chunked.

validate_columns

If TRUE, scan every configured column of every built table and count values that fail to convert (TRY_CAST) to their configured type, stopping the build if a required patient/visit linkage column has any failures or is missing raw data. Off by default (FALSE)

  • this scan touches the full raw data of every table (including huge ones like chartevents) and is expensive; skipping it trusts that the source's linkage columns are already well-formed (a reasonable default for a vetted source like published MIMIC data, less so for a new, unvetted institutional extract). Reference tables are never checked either way.

ignore_errors

If TRUE (default), a raw CSV row that fails to parse (beyond what null_padding/lenient parsing already tolerates) is skipped rather than aborting the whole table's read - avoids losing an entire large import to one bad row. Combined with store_rejects, that row is still recorded, not silently dropped. Set FALSE to fail hard on any malformed row instead.

store_rejects

If TRUE (default), skipped rows (when ignore_errors = TRUE) are recorded - which file/line, which column, why - in the returned csv_reject_report instead of vanishing with no trace. Has no effect when nothing gets skipped.

use_parquet_cache

If TRUE (default), a table whose raw CSV has already been cached as parquet by cache_raw_parquet_duckdb() is read from that parquet instead of re-parsing CSV. Tables without a cached parquet still fall back to CSV. Set FALSE to always read CSV.

overwrite

Safely replace the one current completed Parquet cohort?

show_progress

Print aggregate progress.

cohort_selection

Optional overrides from cohort_selection_options() or a named list.

windows

Optional overrides from window_options() or a named list.

loading

Optional overrides from loading_options() or a named list.

execution

Optional overrides from execution_options() or a named list.

Value

Invisibly returns the normalized plan, reports, status, path, and csv_reject_report (a data frame, one row per rejected raw CSV row, empty if none).

Details

When the cohort is selected by ICD code (a named ICD cohort such as "scid", or a raw icd_filter_path), the exact code list that defined the cohort is also published as a reference table, d_<name>_icds (e.g. d_scid_icds for the bundled SCI cohort; a name derived from the file's basename for a raw icd_filter_path). SQL-based cohorts (e.g. "sepsis3") have no ICD list and get no such table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
import_cohort_general("mimic_iv_demo",
  icd_filter_path = "config/my_icd_codes.csv")
} # }
